**2h**

I worked on the beginning of my Starbie. I'm a little late but I hope to get it done by the due date. I drew out the schematics and have wired together the PCB board. I think I might be missing or have the wrong components but I'm not sure how to get the correct ones. Overall, I think everything is going good so far and I should be able to fix everything by tonight.

### 2026-10-11 – I made a lot of progress in this session but ran into a lot of problems. I first had trouble with making the PCB outline because I had never done that before. Then I tried to wire the board but when I

**3h**

I made a lot of progress in this session but ran into a lot of problems. I first had trouble with making the PCB outline because I had never done that before. Then I tried to wire the board but when I cross referenced it with the tutorial picture I didn't have the same connections at all. I had to go back to my schematics and try and rewire everything, and then I realized that I didn't have a proper footprint for my ESP32. I am proud of the progress I made though and hope to be able to work on this project more.
